title: rotation
description: This mod adds a simple keybind menu with 4 player rotation controls: rotate right, rotate left, aim straight, and instant 360 spin. Designed for quick movement control and smooth gameplay customization.
body:
This project adds a custom keybind menu that allows players to control character rotation and aiming with easy-to-use buttons. The menu can be opened anytime using a configurable keybind, giving quick access to all movement features during gameplay.

The mod includes 4 main actions:

* Rotate the player to the right
* Rotate the player to the left
* Set the aim direction straight
* Perform a full 360° spin instantly

The system is designed to be simple, responsive, and smooth while playing. It can be useful for fun gameplay moments, testing movement controls, or creating unique player animations and rotations. The interface is lightweight and easy to navigate, making all controls accessible from one menu without complicated setup.
